newsitem.title: USA: CARGILL REPORTS FY97 EARNINGS OF $814 MILLION.
newsitem.headline: CARGILL REPORTS FY97 EARNINGS OF $814 MILLION.

text.p: Cargill Inc on Tuesday reported fiscal 1997 earnings of $814 million, down 10 percent from the prior year's record $902 million.
For the year ended May 31, 1997, the company said sales stayed stable at $56 billion and cash flow rose five percent to a record $1.9 billion.
The privately held company said results reflect "strong performances" by businesses such as crop inputs, animal nutrition and meat, commodity trading and financial markets.

But the company said historically tight supplies of grains and oilseeds, and excess capacity burdened many processing businesses, pressure that it expected to continue during the first half of the fiscal year.

"The coming year will be a challenging extension of the current cycle," said Cargill vice chairman Robert Lumpkins in a news release. "While Cargill's businesses are inherently cyclical, and we expect some variability in earnings, ongoing worldwide economic growth bodes well for the company."
Cargill is an global marketer, processor and distributor of agricultural, food, financial and industrial products. -- ((Reuters Chicago Newsdesk (312) 408-8787))
